name: result_semantics_recovery
description: Investigator recovery layer with durable observations, stable measurement IDs, narrow measurement-semantics selection, and deterministic supervisor-controlled failover.
stopping_condition: Stop when the requested concept is directly supported by independent evidence, or when bounded semantic recovery cannot produce new evidence.
decision_contract: Each assigned capability returns only its own minimal schema; candidate assessment is a separate non-routing contract; Python executes and validates transitions.
